upstream.notes: CDC, NIOSH and US Public Health Service PDFs listed in sources.json. CDC moves files between cdc.gov and CDC Stacks fairly often, so an unreachable URL here is a normal finding, not a crisis: validate_manifest.py --network catches it and the pack keeps serving its last good build. The WikiMed companion below is tracked separately and is not part of this hfdb.

companions.problem: Not part of the medical hfdb. Planned as its own linked pack (working id medical-wikimed) once the app can read ZIM files; a manifest entry has exactly one url and one format, so it cannot ride inside this entry. See README.md.

companions.what: Larger WikiMed editions, if 166 MB of intro extracts proves too thin

notes: Hosted hfdb built by scripts/build_pdf_pack.py from public-domain US Government PDFs (packs/medical/sources.json), one search document per page. Hesperian's 'Where There Is No Doctor' is NOT hosted: it is copyrighted and there is no written redistribution permission (spec: Licensing); the Packs screen links to Hesperian's own download page instead. WikiMed is a planned separate linked pack. Nothing medical ships without clinician review: every source carries a reviewNote saying so.
